name: ReasoningQA
intro: ReasoningQA 是 LongCat-Flash-Omni 与 LongCat-Next 报告中 OpenAudioBench 相关音频推理问答分项。
intro_en: ReasoningQA is an audio reasoning QA subset associated with OpenAudioBench in LongCat-Flash-Omni and LongCat-Next reports.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with Baichuan-Audio arXiv:2502.17239 Section 4.3 and Table 8, cross-checked against the baichuan-inc/OpenAudioBench dataset card; LongCat-Flash-Omni only reuses the subset in its result table. ReasoningQA is not a standalone LongCat benchmark paper. It is the self-constructed logical-reasoning component of OpenAudioBench introduced in the Baichuan-Audio report. The official card lists 202 audio items and the report states that each answer is evaluated by GPT-4o against a reference answer before accuracy is calculated. Audio models are tested in speech-to-text mode or non-cascaded speech-to-speech mode; for the latter, interleaved output text is merged for scoring. Later LongCat reports reuse the same named subset in comparative result tables but do not document an alternative construction pipeline.
